topic: T2 regression: inline turn hangs at status running with a real database
lesson: apps/core/test/integration/inline-agent-runtime.integration.test.ts 'runs mocked Claude and OpenAI-compatible inline turns with core tools, remote MCP, and durable records' fails DETERMINISTICALLY on T2's code and passes 8/8 at stage baseline b1e1ac0b0 — same env, same machine, two runs each. The agent run stays at status 'running' for the full 20s vi.waitFor and never completes or errors, so an await on the turn path is not resolving. Bisect: reverting ONLY apps/core/src/runtime/group-agent-runner.ts to baseline makes it pass while T2's ceiling module, settings and events all stay, so the cause is in the runner's changes. Moving raiseProviderSessionMarkFromOutput out of wrappedOnOutput to the post-run point was necessary (T2-AC1 says post-run, T1's R2 says exactly once, and a per-output awaited Postgres write blocks the streaming pipeline) but did NOT fix the hang — it still fails 2/2 after that move. It requires GANTRY_TEST_DATABASE_URL to reproduce: without it the DB-gated integration lanes skip entirely, which is why every verify.py green in this task was blind to it. Remaining suspects in the runner diff: the awaited prepareProviderSessionContext preflight at group-agent-runner.ts:403 and the retireMissingProviderSession replacement of the old local expireTurnProviderSession. The cap getter is synchronous with a try/catch fallback and cannot hang.
source: bisect against b1e1ac0b0; stage done refusals 16:47 and 17:29; 2x2 controlled runs
